panels.description: Application service logs collected from the repository logs directory.
panels.title: Application logs
Autotrader cycle processing to order creation latency
panels.description: Measured AutoTrader processing time from cycle start to signal order creation. Signal age before cycle start is reported separately in the latency breakdown.
Approximate p50 and p95 durations from the Insights signal pipeline. Values are in microseconds; percentiles are calculated from cumulative latency buckets.
panels.title: Insights signal stages (µs)

panels.description: Research records dropped when the bounded persistence queue is full. A nonzero value means research history was shed to keep live signal processing moving.
panels.title: Research records dropped (5m)

panels.description: Signal backlog and source age before processing, plus asynchronous settings and position-ledger snapshots. These are tracked outside the order execution hot path.
panels.title: Queue, signal age and background persistence (ms)

panels.description: Raw stale signal candidates and decision cycles with at least one freshness rejection over the previous five minutes, plus the stale count from the latest decision.
panels.title: Signal staleness

panels.description: Latest, average, and p95 cycle-lock wait and hold durations for every AutoTrader worker. A long hold points to work inside the critical section; a long wait points to lock contention.
panels.title: AutoTrader cycle lock wait and hold

panels.description: Shows non-overlapping sections measured inside position-maintenance cycle-lock holds: settings-mutex wait and ledger reconciliation, plus exit revalidation, reservation preparation, and order recording. Compare these with the full hold above to locate unexplained time.
panels.title: AutoTrader position-maintenance lock breakdown

panels.description: Measured synchronous order path from signal selection through order creation, Position Manager response, and local state update. Shows only work associated with an order; excludes full insight-cycle duration and signal-worker lock waits.
panels.title: AutoTrader order latency (local + network)
AutoTrader realized P&L by strategy
panels.description: Recent realized P&L attributed to the entry strategy. Values are in the symbol quote currency; check the quote label when comparing strategies.
Number of realized outcomes in the same recent activity window as strategy P&L. Use this to judge the sample size behind each strategy result.
panels.title: AutoTrader trade outcomes by strategy
Feed queue depth
panels.description: Current retained messages in each instrumented feed queue.

panels.title: Feed messages dropped
panels.description: Messages skipped by lagging broadcast receivers, per queue.
Health endpoints for Insights, Scouts, and AutoTrader. A service can be UP while its data pipeline is stalled.
panels.title: Insights pipeline health

panels.description: Number of signal snapshots generated by Insights in the last five minutes. NO DATA means no matching recent log entries.
panels.title: Insight snapshots · last 5m

panels.description: Recent Insights WARN or ERROR log entries; inspect Application logs for details.
panels.title: Insights warnings · last 5m

panels.description: Counts from the Insights consumer heartbeat. Flat zero or missing data alongside healthy services indicates an input/data-flow problem, not a queue backlog.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({job="application",service="insights"} |= "FeedHandlers signal-event stream heartbeat" | regexp "price=(?P<events>[0-9]+)" | unwrap events | __error__="" [1m]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="application",service="insights"} |= "FeedHandlers signal-event stream heartbeat" | regexp "trade=(?P<events>[0-9]+)" | unwrap events | __error__="" [1m]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="application",service="insights"} |= "FeedHandlers signal-event stream heartbeat" | regexp "book=(?P<events>[0-9]+)" | unwrap events | __error__="" [1m]))
sum(sum_over_time({job="application",service="insights"} |= "FeedHandlers signal-event stream heartbeat" | regexp "invalid=(?P<events>[0-9]+)" | unwrap events | __error__="" [1m]))
